name: Ait Bouguemez (Happy Valley)
hero_subtitle: Green High Atlas valley — Amazigh villages, apple orchards and classic trekking trails.

overview.title: The Happy Valley of the High Atlas
overview.p1: Ait Bouguemez is a fertile valley of terraced fields, apple orchards and traditional Amazigh villages. It is one of the most beautiful rural landscapes in Morocco.
overview.p2: Trekking paths link villages and passes; guesthouses offer authentic stays. It is ideal for multi-day walks or a peaceful base in the mountains.
overview.p3: Spring and autumn bring the best weather and colours. A local guide enriches village visits and longer hikes.

2.title: Guesthouse pace

3.title: Golden peaks
3.desc: Warm light on the mountains; short hikes and village life.

food.title: Where to eat in Ait Bouguemez
food.p1: Most meals are at mountain guesthouses: home-cooked Amazigh food, garden vegetables and bread from clay ovens.
food.li1: Couscous and tagines made with local produce
food.li2: Fresh bread and olive oil from village ovens
food.li4: Book dinner with your guesthouse if you stay overnight
food.li5: Carry cash for small village shops
food.p2: Cash remains useful for small local places.

1.title: Getting around
1.desc: A car or organised transfer is best. Mountain roads are winding; allow extra time.

2.title: Guides
2.desc: A local guide enriches village visits and longer treks between passes.

3.title: Weather
3.desc: Nights are cold even in spring — pack warm layers and a jacket.

q1.question: How much time for Ait Bouguemez (Happy Valley)?
q1.answer: Plan at least the duration indicated in the info box; longer stays reward hikers.

q2.question: Is it suitable for children?
q2.answer: Yes with supervision on paths and near water or cliffs.

q3.question: Do I need a guide?
q3.answer: Not always required, but recommended for valleys and remote tracks.

q4.question: How to get there?
q4.answer: By road from Azilal, Marrakech or Beni Mellal; 4x4 helpful on some mountain roads.
